name: Quantum Electronics
description: Light propagation through anisotropic media, nonlinear effects, nonlinear polarization, second harmonic generation, SFG and DFG, parametric amplification, fluorescence and oscillation; quasi-phase matching, periodically poled materials and their applications. Third-order effects: self-phase modulations, cross-phase modulation, four-wave mixing, phase conjugation. Quantization of the electromagnetic field; number states, coherent states and their properties: squeezed states and their properties, generation and detection of squeezed states of light; g2(0) and photon coincidence measurement, entangled states, generation, detection and properties; applications in quantum information science: single/entangled photon sources, squeezed light sources and their applications in quantum sensing, quantum communication, QKD, quantum teleportation, quantum networks, quantum radar, quantum computation, etc.
